title: Team member readiness record v1
description: Written by the managed API runtime to .loop/scheduler/team/readiness/<member_id>.json after a real provider response, signed with the local host key and bound to one team digest. team_status reports verified only from such a record, expired once expires_at has passed, and configured_unverified when there is none. Native and CLI members never get one: their support is reported as explicitly unverified.
